claim: For an order-23 Monster element g, C_M(g) is C23 x S4; the five S4 insertion classes give cyclic product families of orders 23, 46, 46, 69 and 92, and every corresponding A/B McKay-Thompson pair is scalar-degenerate. Scalar genus-one centralizer insertions cannot recover orientation.

centralizer.splitReason: <g> is central and gcd(23,24)=1; Schur-Zassenhaus supplies a complement, and the product-class centralizer census identifies its S4 class structure

cyclicReduction.reason: every insertion order in S4 is coprime to 23, so <g,k> is cyclic of order 23*order(k)

powerMap.role: cyclotomic Galois/power-map exchange of distinct A/B Monster classes
